_doc: Robot tab of dtssl gui (dtssl.bridge.telemetry). 'real': the RoboCIn radio telemetry, RCCommunication.Feedback datagrams of rc_communication.proto as received by ssl-unification CommunicationWifi (multicast 224.0.1.99, recv port 19903; commands go out on 19901). enabled=false keeps the receiver off unless `dtssl gui --telemetry`; team = whose robots report (null = the GUI --team); stale_s = a record older than this is not shown; fields = which Feedback group is the commanded vs the measured wheel speed (c_speed / d_speed; swap here if the firmware names them the other way round); units = labels only, as reported by the firmware (correct them here, nothing is converted). 'synthetic': the ILLUSTRATIVE battery/capacitor model of the twin's robots (not identified; the GUI labels it): capacitor empties on a kick and recharges with capacitor_tau_s; battery drains by battery_drain_per_rad * sum|wheel rad/s| * dt.
